result.rationale: The model's before_validation block calls self.host.sub! on the raw value; a nil host (e.g., request without a host field) raises NoMethodError instead of a validation failure. Similarly, save_host dereferences params[:embeddable_host][:host], which raises on missing wrapper key instead of render_json_error. Both mechanisms are verifiable in the diff's new files (app/models/embeddable_host.rb, app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb). Admin-only endpoint with Ember client that always sends the wrapper, so impact is limited, but the crash-instead-of-error path is real.
